# v0.3.36 — Ongoing tasks and recoverable memory

- Follow public GitHub PRs and CI summaries from main chat or the new Ongoing tasks panel. Pause, resume, cancel, check now, and set time/check limits. Changed failures, passes and closure notify main chat; failure analysis has no tools and does not modify code.
- Persist task state, retry delays, leases and notification delivery. Resume eligible work after DSH restarts without replaying missed checks or previous write commands.
- Persist memory proposals before merging; recheck source visibility, settings, evidence and fact versions. Shared facts and automatic extraction retain their existing opt-in settings.
- Queue TheOne-dispatched turns for the same identified project. Other projects can still run concurrently; this is not a cross-process file lock.
- Include the ongoing-task guide in the release archive and fix the Windows packaging command.

Runs on this computer while DSH is open. This first version supports public PRs through the anonymous GitHub API, which may rate limit requests. It reads CI summaries, not full logs. Default limits are 15 minutes, 96 attempts and 24 hours. No cloud runtime, private-repository access or automatic code changes are included.

Validation includes 24 new automated checks, real DSH session/API integration with fixture GitHub/model responses, browser creation/pause/resume/cancel checks, and a live read of the repository's merged PR #11. Model diagnostic accuracy is not established by fixture tests. The publishing workflow runs the complete suite on Linux before publishing.

## 中文

- 新增「持续任务」：可以在主聊天要求跟进公开 GitHub PR，也可在面板创建、暂停、恢复、取消、立即检查，设置次数和时间上限。
- PR / CI 出现新的失败、通过、合并或关闭时通知主聊天。失败分析只读、无工具权限，提供下一步建议，不自行修改代码。
- 任务、重试和通知持久化，重启 DSH 后继续；记忆候选先保存，再核对来源、设置、证据和版本后合并。
- 同一已识别项目的 TheOne 派发回合排队，降低多个话题同时写文件的冲突；其他项目仍可并行。
- 补齐安装包里的功能说明，并修复 Windows 本机打包命令。

当前在本机运行，DSH 关闭期间不会执行；仅支持公开 PR，匿名 GitHub API 可能限流。读取的是 CI 摘要，并非完整日志。默认每 15 分钟检查，最多 96 次、24 小时。共享要点与自动提取仍沿用原开关，默认关闭。
